info.longName: Direxion Daily MSCI Mexico Bull 3X Shares

funds_data.description: The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments, that, in combination, provide 3X daily leveraged exposure to the index, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index is designed to measure the performance of the large-, mid- and small-capitalization segments of the Mexican equity market, covering approximately 99% of the free float-adjusted market capitalization of companies whose stocks are traded primarily on the Mexican Stock Exchange. The fund is non-diversified.
